observation: On the #1178 history a static scope suggestion (tests referencing symbols of scoped files) produced 83 candidates, 17 with a behavior anchor, for 1 real missed dependency (tests/WorkflowPlanCommandTest.php). An executed preflight over a host-validated draft reports exactly that path as observed_out_of_scope_change and nothing for an in-scope change (regression tests). Rev 4 conflated observed drift with proven necessity and Loop-executed validation; the owner rejected both, and Loop holds no authority to run candidate commands before approval.

hypothesis: Pre-approval scope gaps are best surfaced from what a validated draft actually had to change, bound to exact identities and labelled host_reported and advisory, rather than predicted statically; this would have avoided BASE-COMMIT-EXACT rev 2.
validated_conclusion: Implemented workflow preflight start|record and card proof.preflight (TASK-REFINEMENT rev 5): no execution by Loop, identity-bound with stale/unknown never clean, drift as observation with a never-applied proposal; 9 regression tests incl. #1178 positive and in-scope negative. Limits: host-reported results are attribution only; drafts must be linked worktrees and kept until the decision; '.'/'./x' scope entries are not normalized in drift; the text card omits recorded_by.
